objective: One GP calculator; business-save triggers only; Purchase reads have no GP writes or FX calls.

rules.when: First confirmed PO or effective commercial amendment
rules.gp: Calculate affected customer/source values through existing arithmetic
rules.writes: Save only changed GP evidence/cache under existing locks

rules.when: Page load, refresh, background read, view/company/customer navigation
rules.gp: Read last confirmed current cache only

rules.when: PO number change only / dates / documents / payments / messages / personal row order
rules.gp: No calculation unless actual financial basis also changed

rules.when: Borrow, repayment, return, reconciliation, demand cancellation
rules.gp: Recalculate only if the existing formula financial basis changes; preserve exact stock/loan histories
rules.writes: No duplicate stock or accounting writes

rules.gp: Keep original mandatory invoice cache confirmation; freeze issued quantity cost and FX
Do not rewrite PO GP during reads; use saved applicable rate. New SI retains existing fresh-rate snapshot rule

failurePolicy.confirmedBusinessSave: Never repeat, roll back, or alter a confirmed PO/stock/payment operation solely because a derived GP cache fails.
failurePolicy.unconfirmedGp: Do not display stale cache as current or missing data as zero; retain original request for controlled same-save repair.
failurePolicy.locks: Retain GP/COST/Finance locks, source-version checks and invoice immutability.
failurePolicy.legacy: Preserve verified existing PO/invoice values; no read-triggered backfill, dummy PO edit, deletion or invented source margin.

acceptance: Pre-PO read has null GP, zero FX and GP store calls
First PO computes once; repeated reads add no events
Real price/discount/FOC/source changes update only affected current values
Partial coverage: valid supplier GP remains distinct from unknown customer aggregate
Borrow/repay stock and journal writes remain byte/behavior protected
Partial SI retains issued cost/rate; open quantity alone changes
Pure document/payment/date/message/reorder produce no GP work
Cache failure retains business result identity and hides unconfirmed GP
Same-request retry does not duplicate GP or business records
Concurrent amendments/invoice and COST/GP locks remain protected
Old financial snapshots are not rebuilt or rewritten by opening a page
limits: 3028 -> 3028 observed after a user-bookmark visit is limited evidence, not a controlled load or capacity pass.
Public Refresh measurement previously blocked by automatic approval review; no workaround used.
Implementation is local and two Wix drafts matched. No new production publication or controlled initialization claimed.

initialization.approval: User approved one explicit cache initialization, preserving confirmed GP and SI snapshots
initialization.policy: Preview is read-only; bounded five tasks; saved FX only; mismatches skipped; apply requires exact preview identity
initialization.execution: Preview pending; employee mapping denial preserved; only new maintenance method uses Wix Permissions.Admin
